instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures three women in a bright gym setting. On the left, the black-haired woman in a black hoodie (R3) and on the right, the red-haired woman in a black sports bra (R2) are locked in a warm embrace, their arms wrapped around each other. In the center background, the gray-haired woman in a black sports bra (R1) stands facing forward, smiling happily as she watches them. The background shows gym machines and white walls. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the joyful and friendly interaction.
elements: R1 stands in the center background watching the interaction rather than participating in the embrace

R3 has her arms wrapped around R2 as part of the embrace

gym machines are visible in the bright gym setting
the scene has bright, even lighting
